entries.17d825a208fe012c: A company that uses transaction data and AI technology to operate market price search services and a BtoB wholesale mall, and to make business investments.
entries.185c1a0d417ffbda: Consumers who buy products through live streaming and the like
entries.1a4d8c334f034958: It is a business that supports the distribution of companies' inventory and slow-moving products, and operates multiple marketplaces online and offline. In addition to providing the BtoB wholesale mall “NETSEA” and the offline exhibition and business meeting business “OSR Exhibition and Business Meeting,” it operates D2X commerce, which sells products manufactured in China to buyers and consumers in Japan (OEM own-brand sales “AP LAB” and live commerce “NETSEA MallLive”). NETSEA Auction, which had supported the liquidation of slow-moving inventory, returns and discontinued products, ended its service in March 2025. Revenue from external customers in the fiscal year ended September 2025 was ¥1,610 million.
entries.20fcd2d429ce8226: It is a business that sells products manufactured at factories and suppliers in China to buyers and consumers in Japan. OEM own-brand sales “AP LAB” itself develops factories and manufactures at its production bases in China, and in addition to sales to individuals, it also wholesales to corporations. Live commerce “NETSEA MallLive” purchases products itself and sells them through live streaming. Its main revenue model is sales revenue from product transactions. Amounts are not disclosed separately, so they are not stated.
entries.4eadb40e3f4b44d6: Business owners running product-sales businesses as a side job or second job
entries.544a6b3828e014b5: Buyers such as retailers and wholesalers that purchase products
entries.5aa14696e4633515: A business providing mainly the price comparison and market price search site “aucfan.com”, which uses distribution market price data held by the company, as well as the online shop integrated management service “Tatenpo Guide”, the RPA tool “Aucfan Robo”, and the school-format side-business support service “good sellers” for individuals who sell products as a side or second business. Its main sources of revenue are paid subscription income and online advertising income. The Amazon seller-dedicated app “Amacode” was transferred to a third party in February 2025, and the company withdrew from that business. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended September 2025 was ¥2,789 million.
entries.62360da11de62bc6: It is a price comparison and market price search website that uses the distribution price data the company holds. Users can compare and search products across multiple EC sites and auctions, and check past winning-bid price levels. Amounts are not disclosed separately, so they are not stated.
entries.68988e70400e0773: It is an RPA tool that can be operated intuitively without specialist knowledge, automating back-office work such as competitor research, inventory ordering, order processing, shipping slip creation, and personnel and labor administration. Amounts are not disclosed separately, so they are not stated.
entries.6d41623996503090: EC operators that run online shops
entries.7529f81208fb676f: Sole proprietors and side-business operators selling products through auctions or EC (SmallB)
entries.85ed0b48d1b4f164: It is an offline exhibition and business meeting business based in Senba, Osaka, providing suppliers with wholesale sales opportunities and buyers with purchasing opportunities. Its main revenue model consists of settlement fee income from suppliers and booth fee income. Amounts are not disclosed separately, so they are not stated.
entries.92f5f0c8ec645e08: Consumers who buy own-brand products and the like
entries.a23231d89c10fe85: It is a BtoB wholesale mall that matches online manufacturers and wholesalers that hold inventory (suppliers) with retailers and wholesalers that have demand for purchasing a wide range of products (buyers). Its main revenue model consists of distribution fees calculated on distribution value and monthly membership fees charged to suppliers. Amounts are not disclosed separately, so they are not stated.
entries.af58affa775c574d: It is a business aimed at gaining know-how and networks for building and maintaining competitive advantage over the medium to long term through business investment and support for investee companies. Its main sources of revenue are gains on sales of operating investment securities and consulting income from investee companies. It also develops new businesses that serve as the foundation for future growth, and overseas business is also conducted within this segment. Revenue from external customers in the fiscal year ended September 2025 was ¥257 million.
entries.afa3653eab4ba4dc: It is a school-format side-business support service aimed at business owners who run product-sales businesses as a side job or second job. Amounts are not disclosed separately, so they are not stated.
entries.bd1c81dbfe5d20f8: It is an online shop integrated management service that enables bulk registration, editing and updating of product information across multiple EC sites, automatic synchronization of inventory quantities, and automatic import of order information. Amounts are not disclosed separately, so they are not stated.
